invention.ref: Dr. Levi Spear Parmly in New Orleans introduces silk thread for interdental cleaning
invention.ref_zh: 新奥尔良牙医帕姆利主张用无蜡丝线清除牙缝污垢，开启现代牙线洁齿

patent.ref: Johnson & Johnson receives first US patent for dental floss made from leftover suture silk
patent.ref_zh: 强生公司利用制造医用缝合线的蚕丝余料取得首个牙线专利（US608034）

mass_production.ref: Codman & Shurtleff begins commercial manufacturing of unwaxed silk floss, Massachusetts
mass_production.ref_zh: 马萨诸塞州的科德曼与舒特利夫公司开始商业化生产无蜡丝质牙线

popularization.ref: Dr. Charles C. Bass substitutes nylon for silk, dramatically increasing strength and everyday adoption
popularization.ref_zh: 巴斯医生用杜邦尼龙替代易断裂的天然蚕丝，推动尼龙牙线成为全球家庭日常必需品

sources.title: History of Dental Floss — Library of Congress

summary_zh: 1815 年新奥尔良牙医帕姆利提出用丝线清洁牙缝。1898 年强生将外科缝合线余料制成商品牙线，二战后尼龙的发明让牙线彻底融入日常口腔护理。
summary_en: In 1815 New Orleans dentist Levi Spear Parmly recommended silk thread for flossing. Johnson & Johnson patented it in 1898, and post-WWII nylon made dental floss an everyday bathroom staple.
